name: missinglink
author: MissingShip
description: The Missing Link (Kaze Emanuar's v2.0) on SoH: Unbound. The first time, it makes ML's world from your Ocarina of Time USA 1.0 ROM and Kaze's v2.0 patch (romhacking.net/hacks/5334): it asks for them, saves MissingLink_Unbound.o2r in the mods folder and asks to restart. Install it on its own: packs made for vanilla Ocarina of Time's world, textures or music don't apply to ML.
